title: GenderAlign: An Alignment Dataset for Mitigating Gender Bias in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Human and LLM evaluators ranking generated responses based on the degree of gender bias exhibited, alongside quantitative evaluations using the BBQ (Bias Benchmark for QA) for ambiguous/disambiguated context bias scores and the WinoGender benchmark for measuring Pearson correlation between female-gendered pronoun probabilities and occupational gender statistics.
